title: On Consistency
description: The unsexy truth about getting better at anything.
content:
Consistency is boring. That's the whole point.

When something feels exciting, you do it. When it doesn't, you don't — that's where most people stop. The gap between someone who improves and someone who doesn't is just showing up on the days it doesn't feel exciting.

I'm not naturally consistent. I get obsessed, burn bright for a few weeks, then drop it. This blog is partly an attempt to change that.

Let's see how it goes.
